title: WeaponModelSwaps catalog
description: Lets a weapon skin (an OMOD) change what a weapon looks like by loading different meshes while the skin is applied.
x-help:
A weapon skin is an OMOD (a weapon mod) that, while it is attached, makes the game load a different mesh in place of one of the weapon's own meshes. Fallout 76 weapon skins work this way, and Fallout 4 has no equivalent, so Tales does it for you.

Each skin below is one OMOD plus a list of mesh pairs. A pair reads 'replace this mesh -> with this mesh'. Whenever the weapon loads the first mesh (the weapon itself, or any of its attachments), the game loads the second one instead. Pairs that do not match anything the weapon loads are simply ignored.

Example: a skin OMOD 'Fire Hydrant Bat' with the pair Weapons\BaseballBat\BaseballBat.nif -> Weapons\BaseballBat\BaseballBat_Hydrant.nif. Apply the skin at the workbench and the bat is drawn with the hydrant mesh, in first person, third person and on NPCs.

If the replacement mesh is not found at run time the original mesh is kept, so a wrong path never breaks the weapon. If several skins are attached to one weapon, the first one that lists the mesh wins.
